detailed_descriptions_html.en:
Relive your school memories... but something doesn't want you to leave.

Sabado is a Filipino anime-style p̴̱̾s̸̙̐y̵̗̍c̵̢̓h̸͎̎o̶̲̽l̸̜̄o̷͓͗ḡ̴̘ḭ̵̓c̴̘̈a̸̠͑l̴̥̔ m̷̨̋y̴̥̿s̵tery horror game about revisiting your old high school and reliving the memories you thought were long forgotten.

Walk through familiar classrooms, wander quiet hallways, and explore places that once felt like home. Meet Chesa, a cheerful friend who seems happy to see you again, and spend time talking, laughing, and remembering the little moments you once shared together and uncover stories left behind by the people who were once there.

Every corner of Kiwi High School is filled with nostalgia. The soft atmosphere, familiar locations, and quiet music create the feeling of returning to a place that has been waiting for you all this time. It is a journey about friendship, memories, and rediscovering the past one step at a time.

Or at least...

that's what Jacob thought.

Because the school isn't empty.

The exits begin to disappear.

The hallways no longer lead where they should.

Someone has been watching you since the moment you arrived.

And Chesa...

...already knows why you came back.
